intro.title: What we run for people who want in.
intro.lede: KR8 Digitals is a company. Alongside the client work we run four programmes: free training, a community, a gathering, and a route into working with us. They exist because the company needs people who can build, and because talent should not need money to prove itself.
intro.imageAlt: The KR8 Digitals Academy homepage as it appears live

programmes.name: Free Training
programmes.imageAlt: A partner school site built for learners
programmes.lede: Digital skills through KR8 Academy, academics through Next Gen Scholars. Both are free.
programmes.body: The free training has two doors. Walk through the digital door and you learn a craft — graphic design with Motionverse, video editing with CHIGOMA, and the web, content, social and marketing tracks taught by the KR8 team. Walk through the academic door and Next Gen Scholars teaches the subjects that get you through WAEC and JAMB, sciences or arts. Neither door asks for tuition.
programmes.commitment: One cohort at a time · classes and assignments each week

doors.name: Digital Skills
doors.line: Graphic design, video editing, web development, content, social media and digital marketing — seven tracks taught by people doing the work.
doors.partner: Motionverse teaches graphic design · CHIGOMA teaches video editing

doors.name: Academics
doors.line: Sciences and arts, WAEC and JAMB preparation, taught by Next Gen Scholars so a school leaver has options, not one narrow road.
doors.partner: Next Gen Scholars teaches the academic door

programmes.name: The Tribe
programmes.imageAlt: A member of the KR8 community filmed for their story
programmes.lede: The community where people who train with us keep working together after the cohort ends.
programmes.body: A cohort ends and most people lose the room: no one to review the work, no one to send a lead, no one to say that is not good enough yet. The Tribe is that room kept open. Critique, opportunities, and the company of people building the same thing you are.
programmes.commitment: Open to people who have trained with us

programmes.name: Mindset Shift
programmes.imageAlt: Event artwork in the KR8 design style
programmes.lede: A gathering built to change what a young person believes is possible for themselves.
programmes.body: Skill is not the only gap. Plenty of capable people never start because nobody ever showed them someone like them who did. Mindset Shift puts those people in a room — speakers who built something, and a room of people deciding to.
programmes.commitment: Dates, speakers and venue confirmed per edition

programmes.name: Join the Team
programmes.imageAlt: A KR8 Digitals founder at work
programmes.lede: The route from learning with us to working with us — on real client projects, not practice briefs.
programmes.body: The people who build our client work came through the same training. Join the Team is how that happens: you come in, you work on live projects with people who have shipped, and you are held to the standard the client paid for.
programmes.commitment: Portfolio review · working interviews on live work

principles.d: Every fact on this site is either verified or marked as a placeholder waiting for the team to confirm it.
The portfolio is live sites, real flyers and real films. Nothing here is a mockup.
You should not need money to learn a craft, and you should not need to know somebody to be considered.
